question: Can you calculate the 5-day symmetric moving average of predicted toy sales for December 5 to 8, 2018, using daily sales data from January 1, 2017, to August 29, 2018, with a simple linear regression model? Finally provide the sum of those four 5-day moving averages?
sql:
WITH regression_params AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(daily_sales, day_of_year) as slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(daily_sales, day_of_year) as intercept
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) as sale_date, 
            SUM(price) as daily_sales,
            CAST(strftime('%j', DATE(order_purchase_timestamp)) AS INTEGER) as day_of_year
        FROM order_items oi
        JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
        WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <= '2018-08-29 23:59:59'
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_category_name_translation pct 
                    WHERE pct.product_category_name = (SELECT product_category_name FROM products p WHERE p.product_id = oi.product_id)
                    AND pct.product_category_name_english = 'toys')
        GROUP BY DATE(order_purchase_timestamp)
    )
),
all_predictions AS (
    SELECT 
        r.slope,
        r.intercept,
        day_of_year,
        r.slope * day_of_year + r.intercept as predicted_sales
    FROM regression_params r,
    LATERAL (
        SELECT 337 as day_of_year
        UNION ALL SELECT 338
        UNION ALL SELECT 339
        UNION ALL SELECT 340
        UNION ALL SELECT 341
        UNION ALL SELECT 342
        UNION ALL SELECT 343
        UNION ALL SELECT 344
    ) p
),
ma5_for_dec5 AS (
    SELECT (p337.predicted_sales + p338.predicted_sales + p339.predicted_sales + p340.predicted_sales + p341.predicted_sales) / 5.0 as ma5_value
    FROM all_predictions p337, all_predictions p338, all_predictions p339, all_predictions p340, all_predictions p341
    WHERE p337.day_of_year = 337 AND p338.day_of_year = 338 AND p339.day_of_year = 339 AND p340.day_of_year = 340 AND p341.day_of_year = 341
),
ma5_for_dec6 AS (
    SELECT (p338.predicted_sales + p339.predicted_sales + p340.predicted_sales + p341.predicted_sales + p342.predicted_sales) / 5.0 as ma5_value
    FROM all_predictions p338, all_predictions p339, all_predictions p340, all_predictions p341, all_predictions p342
    WHERE p338.day_of_year = 338 AND p339.day_of_year = 339 AND p340.day_of_year = 340 AND p341.day_of_year = 341 AND p342.day_of_year = 342
),
ma5_for_dec7 AS (
    SELECT (p339.predicted_sales + p340.predicted_sales + p341.predicted_sales + p342.predicted_sales + p343.predicted_sales) / 5.0 as ma5_value
    FROM all_predictions p339, all_predictions p340, all_predictions p341, all_predictions p342, all_predictions p343
    WHERE p339.day_of_year = 339 AND p340.day_of_year = 340 AND p341.day_of_year = 341 AND p342.day_of_year = 342 AND p343.day_of_year = 343
),
ma5_for_dec8 AS (
    SELECT (p340.predicted_sales + p341.predicted_sales + p342.predicted_sales + p343.predicted_sales + p344.predicted_sales) / 5.0 as ma5_value
    FROM all_predictions p340, all_predictions p341, all_predictions p342, all_predictions p343, all_predictions p344
    WHERE p340.day_of_year = 340 AND p341.day_of_year = 341 AND p342.day_of_year = 342 AND p343.day_of_year = 343 AND p344.day_of_year = 344
)
SELECT 
    'Dec 5' as pred_date, ma5_for_dec5.ma5_value as ma5,
    'Dec 6' as pred_date2, ma5_for_dec6.ma5_value as ma5_2,
    'Dec 7' as pred_date3, ma5_for_dec7.ma5_value as ma5_3,
    'Dec 8' as pred_date4, ma5_for_dec8.ma5_value as ma5_4,
    ma5_for_dec5.ma5_value + ma5_for_dec6.ma5_value + ma5_for_dec7.ma5_value + ma5_for_dec8.ma5_value as total_sum
FROM ma5_for_dec5, ma5_for_dec6, ma5_for_dec7, ma5_for_dec8
